# FastDepth

Depth Estimation · `fastdepth_224x224` · DX-APP C++ example

Depth Estimation model, evaluated on NYU Depth V2.

**Input** 224 × 224 × 3 · **Dataset** NYU Depth V2 · **License** MIT · **Quantization** Q-Lite, Q-Pro

![FastDepth output](../../../../python_example/depth_estimation/fastdepth/fastdepth_224x224/result.webp)

Full card with copy buttons and dark/light theme (open it in a browser; GitHub shows its source): [model.html](../../../../python_example/depth_estimation/fastdepth/fastdepth_224x224/model.html)

## Quick start

Run from the dx_app root after `./install.sh` and `./build.sh`.

```bash
# from the dx_app root
./setup_sample_models.sh --models FastDepth_1
```

**C++**

```bash
./build.sh --target fastdepth_224x224_sync   # once
./bin/fastdepth_224x224_sync \
  -m assets/models/fastdepth_224x224.dxnn \
  -i sample/img/sample_parking.jpg
```

**Python**

```bash
python src/python_example/depth_estimation/fastdepth/fastdepth_224x224/fastdepth_224x224_sync.py \
  --model assets/models/fastdepth_224x224.dxnn \
  --image sample/img/sample_parking.jpg
```

## Accuracy

| Quantization | RMSE |
|---|---:|
| Raw · ONNX | 0.61 |
| Q-Lite | 0.62 (+0.01) |
| Q-Pro | 0.64 (+0.03) |

NYU Depth V2 · difference vs Raw in brackets.
